title: NASA Mars Trek WMTS imagery
description: Global Viking and MOLA visualization; regional CTX and HiRISE mosaics. Coverage and native resolution vary. Imagery is not numerical elevation.
resolution: 232 m Viking; 463 m MOLA relief; 6 m CTX; 0.25 m HiRISE native source imagery
crs: NASA published angular Mars matrices / explicit Mars sphere in app
processing: Direct NASA WMTS; capabilities-derived tile grids and coverage
limitations: No global sub-metre coverage; imagery and terrain resolutions differ
usage: Credit NASA/JPL/USGS and product contributors; see original product metadata

title: MGS MOLA global DEM, 463 m
description: Preserved supplied 46,080 × 23,040 int16 global DEM. V2 numerical elevation overlay and coarse terrain derivative average to 1440 × 720 cells.
resolution: 463.0935 m projected source; V2 derived cells 0.25° (~14.8 km north–south; east–west varies with latitude)
processing: Rasterio average resampling; periodic longitude and latitude-corrected finite-difference slopes. Cell means hide local terrain. See processed metadata and checksums.
limitations: Interpolated gaps, sparse polar data; no rock-scale hazards
usage: CC0/public domain per USGS product metadata

title: Mars 2020 TRN CTX DTM mosaic, 20 m
description: Native numerical elevation grid for supported Jezero routing; 1,596 × 1,512 samples. Research-grade terrain analysis, not astronaut safety validation.
format: Source GeoTIFF float32; browser little-endian arrays
processing: Native grid, no elevation resampling. Invalid sentinel and nonfinite cells masked. Centred finite differences; edge derivatives one-sided. Slope unavailable next to missing terrain. Little-endian float32 arrays.
limitations: 20 m projected grid does not resolve rocks or guarantee traversability.; High-resolution imagery is not high-resolution elevation.; Grid slope and edge grade do not capture every hazard.
usage: USGS product requests author citation; see Fergason et al. 2020 / original metadata

title: Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature
description: Planetocentric, east-positive representative feature centres; not rover landing positions or precise sampling targets. Region exceptions link to their own coordinate evidence.
limitations: Large regions represented by approximate centres; not local science targets

title: Mars Climate Database v6.2
description: Numerical MCD 6.2 web export: temperature, pressure and horizontal wind speed. Ls 21.3°, local 00:00 at every longitude, 10 m above local surface, climatology average solar scenario. Model means, not weather.
format: ASCII numerical export → locked JSON fields and interpolated PNGs
coverage: Global nodes including poles and duplicate date-line endpoints
resolution: 64 × 48 export nodes (5.714° longitude × 3.830° latitude); native model resolution not established by this export
processing: Reconstructed producer linspace coordinates because ASCII longitudes are integer-truncated. Transposed and reversed to north-up; seam columns averaged with differences recorded. Generated PNG pixels by numerical bilinear resampling at pixel centres, avoiding a half-cell registration shift.
limitations: Model means omit extremes; no live weather, route-scale accuracy or climate routing penalty. High-resolution topographic correction is not high-resolution meteorology.
usage: MCD © LMD/OU/IAA/ESA/CNES. Noncommercial scientific use with attribution and notification. User confirmed author notification sent on 2026-11-14. Terms: https://www-mars.lmd.jussieu.fr/mars/access ; credits: https://www-mars.lmd.jussieu.fr/mcd_python/credit.html
